title: WHOOP MG and the Old Device
lessons: The player first notices WHOOP through the Life tier and its WHOOP MG heart-health features rather than fitness tracking.
The player upgrades and WHOOP suggests giving the old 4.0 device to someone else, with shop credit if that person becomes a member.

text: The player first notices WHOOP through the Life tier and its WHOOP MG heart-health features rather than fitness tracking.

entry-first-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: ECG? I thought you were a workout band.

entry-first-2.speaker: WHOOP
text: That description is getting less complete.

entry-first-4.speaker: WHOOP
text: WHOOP Life uses the MG hardware for ECG readings, AFib detection, and additional heart-health features where supported.

choice-first.speaker: WHOOP
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: That makes the device feel more substantial.
I would want to know exactly which features are regulated and available to me.
I do not want medical-style signals on a lifestyle wearable.

first-1.speaker: WHOOP
text: Good. The value is in specific capabilities, not the word advanced.

first-2.speaker: WHOOP
text: Correct. Region, age, and feature limitations matter. Read them before buying the tier.

first-3.speaker: WHOOP
text: Reasonable. More serious data can create more serious attention than you want.
The player upgrades and WHOOP suggests giving the old 4.0 device to someone else, with shop credit if that person becomes a member.

entry-return-1.speaker: WHOOP
text: Do not throw the 4.0 in a drawer.

entry-return-2.speaker: PLAYER
text: I was absolutely going to throw the 4.0 in a drawer.

entry-return-3.speaker: WHOOP
text: Give it to a friend. If they become a member through the upcycle path, you can get Shop credit.

entry-return-4.speaker: PLAYER
text: So even my old hardware can recruit.

choice-return.speaker: WHOOP
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: I like giving the old device another life.
The credit makes the gift feel like a referral.
I do not want my friends becoming part of my membership economics.

return-1.speaker: WHOOP
text: Then give it because it is useful and let the credit be secondary.

return-2.speaker: WHOOP
text: Yes. Giving the old band a second life can also bring me a new member. Both things are true.

return-3.speaker: WHOOP
text: Then hand them the device with no pitch, or keep it. You do not owe me a recruit.
